$comment: Single status enum and exit-code table for skill parity. Read by lib/parity/check.mjs (node) and mirrored by scripts/sync-companion-clis.sh --print-status-table (bash); tests/test-parity-status-table.sh fails when the two diverge. Docs anchor for every status: docs/skill-parity.md#status-<lowercase-with-dashes>.

MATCH.summary: Every compared file is byte-identical to the reference release.

EXCEPTION.summary: Differences exist, but each one is covered by a complete, documented host/file exception record.

NOT_CONFIGURED.summary: The host has no OPS install and is not in the required set.

APPLIED.summary: An apply step ran and the target was verified against the reference afterwards.

DRIFT.summary: At least one compared file is missing, extra or has different bytes.

DEV_SOURCE.summary: The target points at a developer checkout, not at the reference release. Left untouched.

MISSING_REQUIRED.summary: A required host has no OPS install, or its consumer could not be found.

MISSING_REFERENCE.summary: No local reference release to compare against. Nothing was fetched.

UNREADABLE.summary: A target or registry file exists but could not be read or parsed.

STALE_SOURCE.summary: The cached reference is older than the ref it claims to represent.

STALE_SCAN.summary: The reference or target changed while it was being compared.

AMBIGUOUS_CONSUMER.summary: More than one candidate install exists and the host's own state does not say which one it loads.

NOT_CHECKED.summary: A required target was left out of this run by a diagnostic host selection.

MISSING_COMMAND.summary: A command needed to verify the target is not available.

UNSUPPORTED_SAFE_APPLY.summary: No proven safe way to update this host automatically. The previous registration was kept.

OWNERSHIP_CONFLICT.summary: Applying would overwrite or delete a file OPS does not own. Nothing was changed.

APPLY_FAILED.summary: The apply step failed. The previous registration was kept.

LOCKED.summary: Another OPS run holds the lock for this target root.
